note: Signature-verification cases. traveler_cases: verify `traveler` (JSON text) against the named directory of directory-cases.json at at_ms under `root` (default root_public_key_hex) and produce exactly `want`: one check per buyer signature, the award check (null: no award), one check per quote (null: unsigned), and `verified` (a valid buyer signature and, if there is an award, a valid award). A passing check carries the signing kid and the org the directory binds it to; a refused check carries the REASON, which is normative - an implementation that refuses for a different reason has a different rule. itar_cases: the ITAR gate's answer for (traveler, quote): null (allowed) or the reason it is refused.
